title: How The LuxExperience B.V (NYSE:LUXE) Narrative Is Shifting After Share Count And Valuation Reset
content:
Never miss an important update on your stock portfolio and cut through the noise. Over 7 million investors trust Simply Wall St to stay informed where it matters for FREE.

The latest update on LuxExperience B.V. comes with a lower fair value estimate, trimmed from $10.58 to $10.44, following refreshed modeling work. Analysts link this change directly to the corrected fully diluted share count of 140.1M. This has also influenced the rating shift from Overweight to Neutral and reset expectations around the stock’s risk and reward profile. As the story develops, you will see how these revisions feed into the evolving narrative and what to watch for next in the research.

Analyst Price Targets don't always capture the full story. Head over to our Company Report to find new ways to value LuxExperience B.V.

What Wall Street Has Been Saying

🐂 Bullish Takeaways

JPMorgan has stayed engaged on LuxExperience B.V., updating its research multiple times, which signals that the stock remains on the radar for a major Wall Street firm. The firm previously saw enough upside potential to rate the stock Overweight, suggesting that, at one point, JPMorgan viewed the risk and reward balance as attractive relative to its coverage universe.

🐻 Bearish Takeaways

JPMorgan cut its rating to Neutral from Overweight and reduced its price target to US$10 from US$14 after LuxExperience corrected its Q2 2026 fully diluted share count to 140.1m from 87.2m, indicating a more cautious stance on valuation. The latest fine tuning of the fair value estimate to US$10.44 following JPMorgan's revisions highlights how sensitive the investment case is to share count and earnings assumptions, which can limit upside if further adjustments occur.

What's in the News

LuxExperience B.V. issued updated earnings guidance for the full fiscal year 2026, focusing expectations on the impact of its transformation plan. The company reaffirmed that guidance will remain based on Gross Merchandise Value, with FY26 GMV now guided to a range of €2.5b to €2.7b compared with the prior range of €2.4b to €2.7b. Management reported that the transformation plan is being executed in line with internal targets, which supports the decision to narrow the FY26 guidance ranges.

How This Changes the Fair Value For LuxExperience B.V

Fair value adjusted from US$10.58 to US$10.44 based on refreshed modeling work. Revenue growth assumption revised from 14.68% to 14.17% in € terms. Net profit margin assumption moved from 4.64% to 4.74% on € revenue. Future P/E multiple updated from 13.83x to 13.36x on forward earnings. Discount rate shifted from 8.29% to 8.33% as the required return on equity.

title: JPMorgan cautions staff on use of prediction markets, warns against insider trading - report
content:
[jpmorgan chase]
LewisTsePuiLung/iStock Editorial via Getty Images

JPMorgan Chase (JPM [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/JPM]) CEO Jamie Dimon issued guidelines on the use of prediction markets by employees, potentially allowing staff to trade on such platforms with caution, Barron's reported [https://www.barrons.com/articles/jpmorgan-prediction-markets-kalshi-polymarket-0ed2457c] on Thursday, citing a copy of the guidance.

In a guidance circulated to employees this spring, Dimon asked the company's 320,000 employees to limit their participation in prediction markets involving JPMorgan Chase, citing that it could be perceived as a misuse of information.

He warned against insider trading, but didn't require staff to pre-clear prediction market trading activity with the company.

Dimon had said in an interview with CBS News [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/jamie-dimon-prediction-markets-jpmorgan/] in late March that he thinks, for the most part, the prediction market trading activity is more like gambling.

Major prediction markets are operated by Polymarket (POLYMARKET [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/POLYMARKET]), Kalshi (KALSHI [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/KALSHI]), and PredictIt. However, brokers are starting to offer their clients access to them, including Robinhood Markets (HOOD [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/HOOD]) and Interactive Brokers (IBKR [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/IBKR]).

Even Wall Street bank Goldman Sachs (GS [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/GS]) is considering entering prediction markets. [https://seekingalpha.com/news/4539633-goldman-considers-entry-into-prediction-markets-david-solomon-says#hasComeFromMpArticle=false#source=section%3Amain_content%7Cbutton%3Abody_link%7Cfirst_level_url%3Anews]

"Think carefully before participating in markets related to the financial sector," JPM's guidance reportedly says, noting that employees should never use confidential or material, nonpublic information to transact.

Notably, in late April, credit rating agency KBRA banned [https://www.kbra.com/publications/zccWKVVy/kbra-announces-companywide-prohibition-on-employee-participation-in-prediction-markets] employees from prediction market trading on the back of "regulatory, compliance, and reputational risks associated with these rapidly evolving platforms".

Similarly, last week, the U.S. Senate passed [https://seekingalpha.com/news/4583621-senators-ban-themselves-from-betting-in-prediction-markets] a bipartisan resolution that bans senators from making bets on prediction markets amid mounting insider trading concerns.

title: Ares-Led Group Backs Apollo's GoodLife Investment With $800 Million Financing
content:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus.

Ares Management (NYSE:ARES), Antares Capital and JPMorgan Chase & Co. (NYSE:JPM) have provided around $800 million in private credit financing to support Apollo Global Management's investment in the GoodLife Group, according to people familiar with the matter. The financing included a $675 million first-lien term loan and a $125 million revolver, the people said, offering Apollo debt backing for its investment in one of Canada's largest fitness operators. Representatives for Ares, JPMorgan and Apollo declined to comment, while representatives for Antares and GoodLife did not immediately respond to requests for comment.

Warning! GuruFocus has detected 4 Warning Signs with ARES. Is ARES fairly valued? Test your thesis with our free DCF calculator.

The deal could be another sign that private credit capital is moving deeper into the wellness and fitness space, where lenders have already backed health franchises such as Equinox, Crunch Fitness and EoS Fitness. The industry struggled during Covid, but has since seen renewed momentum as younger generations place more value on in-person fitness, according to a McKinsey & Co. report. For investors, that could make GoodLife part of a broader consumer and private credit story, where recurring membership businesses with large physical footprints are possibly drawing more interest from alternative lenders.

GoodLife was founded by David Patchell-Evans in 1979 and calls itself Canada's largest fitness operator, with more than 400 clubs and around 1.5 million members across the country. The Apollo transaction marked GoodLife's first institutional investment, with the company saying in a February press release that Apollo's minority investment would help accelerate its ambitious growth plans. Patchell-Evans remains chairman, while Jeff van Haeren continues as chief executive officer and president, keeping the company's existing leadership in place as it enters a new capital-backed growth phase.

title: Lockton Closes on $600 million Term Loan and $1.6 Billion Revolving Credit Line
content:
KANSAS CITY, Mo., May 7, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Lockton, the world's largest privately held, independent insurance brokerage, today said it closed on a new seven-year $600 million term loan and a $1.6 billion revolving line of credit.Lockton Logo (PRNewsfoto/Lockton)

The new term loan enhances Lockton's capital structure and supports the firm's private and independent model as well as its strategy of delivering tailored solutions, expertise, and a full range of capabilities to clients in more than 160 countries.

Proceeds from the new term loan, due May 2033, will be used to retire $377 million in existing corporate debt, for recapitalization and general corporate purposes. The pricing on the term loan, SOFR + 200, demonstrates the strength of Lockton's credit profile.

The new revolving line of credit, due in May 2031, replaces an existing $1.1 billion line.

JPMorgan Chase Bank N.A., BofA Securities, BMO Capital Markets, Lloyds Bank, and U.S. Bank arranged the term loan and revolving line of credit.

About Lockton

What makes Lockton stand apart is also what makes us better: independence. Lockton's private ownership empowers its 14,000+ Associates doing business in 160 countries to focus solely on clients' risk and insurance needs. With expertise that reaches around the globe, Lockton delivers the deep understanding needed to accomplish remarkable results. For more information, visit www.lockton.com.

title: Umicore - Transparency notification by JP Morgan Chase & Co.
content:
Umicore

Transparency notification by
JP Morgan Chase & Co.

In accordance with article 14, § 1 of the law of 2 May 2007 on the disclosure of major holdings, Umicore was recently notified by JP Morgan Chase & Co. that it has crossed the legal threshold of 3% for the direct voting rights and equivalent financial instruments upwards on 27 April 2026.

The total holding of direct voting rights and equivalent financial instruments of JP Morgan Chase & Co. stands at 3.06% on 27 April 2026.

Summary of the move:

Date on which the threshold was crossed Date of notification Direct voting rights after the transaction Equivalent financial instruments after the transaction Total 27 April 2026 30 April 2026 0.68% 2.38% 3.06%

Notification from JP Morgan Chase & Co.:

The notification contains the following information:

Date of notification: 30 April 2026 Date on which the threshold is crossed: 27 April 2026 Threshold of direct voting rights and equivalent financial instruments crossed upwards: 3% Notification by: JP Morgan Chase & Co. Denominator: 246,400,000 Reason for notification: Acquisition or disposal of voting securities or voting rights

The chain of control has been described at the end of the notification and can be found here.

About Umicore

Umicore is a global advanced materials and recycling Group. Leveraging decades of expertise in materials science, metallurgy, chemistry, and metals management, Umicore transforms precious and critical metals into functional technologies that enable everyday applications. Its unique circular business model ensures that these critical elements are continuously refined and recycled, to be reintegrated in new applications.

Umicore’s four Business Groups – Catalysis, Recycling, Specialty Materials and Battery Materials Solutions – offer materials and solutions addressing resource scarcity and the growing need for functional materials for clean technologies, clean mobility and a connected world. Through tailored and cutting-edge products and processes they drive innovation and sustainability.

Umicore generates the majority of its revenues from, and focuses most of its R&D efforts on, clean mobility and recycling. Its overriding goal of sustainable value creation is rooted in developing, producing and recycling materials for a better life.

Umicore’s industrial, commercial and R&D activities, with more than 11,000 employees, are located across the world to best serve its global customer base. Group revenues (excluding metal) reached € 3.6 billion (turnover of € 19.4 billion) in 2025.
